sv.title: Pizza Hut återvänder till Sverige
sv.summary: Den 9 september skrev Di att bolaget som driver Pizza Hut i Sverige försatts i konkurs. Nu ser den amerikanska pizzakedjan ut att återvända.

en.title: Pizza Hut Returns to Sweden
en.summary: On 9 September, Di reported that the company operating Pizza Hut in Sweden had been declared bankrupt. Now the American pizza chain appears set to return.
